AcademicOrder.name: AcademicOrder
AcademicOrder.description: Represents a junction between an academic interval, such as an academic term, and an order.

AcademicIntervalId.description: The academic interval that's associated with the order.

ContactId.description: The contact that's associated with the Academic Order.

Description.description: The description of the academic order.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

Name.description: The name of the academic order.

OrderDetailsIdentifier.description: The execution identifier that's associated with the academic order.

OrderId.description: The order that's associated with the academic order.
